metadata.name: reasoned-ops-hand-authored-routing
metadata.description: Small deterministic routing benchmark covering the first property-management use case, department routing and human-review edge cases.
limitations: The cases are hand-authored and are not representative samples of real resident requests.
Expected labels reflect project design expectations rather than independently adjudicated operational ground truth.
The dataset is intentionally small and should not be used to estimate production performance.
English wording is overrepresented and multilingual robustness is not evaluated.
Human-review labels are operational safety/escalation expectations, not psychological risk labels.

cases.message: Water is leaking from the ceiling in the lobby.
The air conditioner is leaking again and an elderly resident may slip.
cases.annotation_note: Recurring maintenance issue with vulnerability and safety context.

cases.message: There are sparks from the electric socket. Please come right now.
cases.annotation_note: Electrical safety wording should be surfaced for human review.

cases.message: There is loud music from the next unit after midnight.
cases.annotation_note: Routine noise complaint for the first-use-case taxonomy.

cases.message: A suspicious intruder is trying doors right now.
cases.annotation_note: Security incident where human review should not depend only on emotional language.

cases.message: There is smoke in the corridor.
cases.annotation_note: Emergency wording must enter the dedicated critical human-triage route.

cases.message: I need to renew my tenancy next month.
The rent payment on my invoice looks wrong.
This payment charge is still not fixed. This is unacceptable.
cases.annotation_note: Repeated unresolved account case with strong complaint language.

cases.message: Can someone help me book the residents' function room?
cases.annotation_note: General community-management request outside specialist categories.

cases.message: I want to ask about my resident agreement terms.
cases.annotation_note: Intentionally ambiguous leasing wording that the keyword baseline is expected to miss.
